subject: Coordination: regulatory private pilot — compressed calendar mosaic & evidence window
messages:
From: Natalie Park <natalie@horizon-labs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Private deployment intake + pilot window

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — we completed the self-serve intake form and selected the Private (VPC) deployment option. We're a regulated fintech team and need a tight 2-week pilot window for the PoC.

Attached is a short RFP-style requirements doc that lists must-have controls (data residency, tenant isolation, audit logs) and our SOC 2 baseline. Can your team run a compressed two-session technical + ops walkthrough next week?

Attendees: myself (product lead), Diego (IT ops), and our security manager (cc'd ITOps team address).

Prefer mornings EST.

Thanks,
Natalie Park
Senior Product Manager | Horizon Labs
attachments: Horizon_RFP_requirements.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Park <natalie@horizon-labs.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake + pilot window

Hi Natalie — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the RFP doc, that helps a lot.

We can absolutely support a compressed pilot. Suggestion: two 90-minute sessions on consecutive mornings — Session 1: technical architecture & networking (Redwood infra, VPC peering options, ingress/egress controls); Session 2: operations and evidence review (SOC 2 artifacts, logging, rollout plan).

Proposed slots (EST):
- Tue Jan 10, 09:00–10:30
- Wed Jan 11, 09:00–10:30

If those don't work, we can move earlier by an hour or offer afternoon alternatives. Can you confirm attendees for each session (we'll include our infra lead + solutions engineer + compliance lead)? Also, we'll need a sample network topology and a point of contact who can approve temporary test VPN access for the hands-on portion.

I've attached our private onboarding guide and a short ops runbook to set expectations. I'll drop a Calendly link for quick slot confirms in a follow-up from Aditya.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0192
attachments: redwood-private-onboarding-guide.pdf
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jan 2028 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake + pilot window

Hi Natalie — quick handoff from SDR/intake. Appreciate the clear asks.

To make the pilot actionable in two business days, can Horizon confirm: (1) a single network contact for temporary access approval, (2) whether you prefer VPC peering or customer-hosted proxy (we'll prepare both flows), and (3) your procurement/legal gate — will that block kickoff until signed?

I've provisioned two tentative calendar holds and included a one-click Calendly below so you can pick the precise time. If you prefer to shift earlier by an hour, that's simple — we left an alternate earlier slot open on the same days.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/onprem-90min?slot=eqs8

Also attaching the runbook we referenced (ops checklist + evidence list) so your security manager can pre-seed items.

Thanks — I'll update the HubSpot deal record (DEAL-2028-HZ-1197) with the selected slots.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao | SDR, Redwood Inference
